entities.summary: The White Factory is a classicist building in Łódź, Poland, constructed in 1835–1839 as part of a textile factory complex belonging to Ludwik Geyer. It currently hosts the Central Museum of Textiles and the Harnam Folk Dance Ensemble. It is considered an example of early industrial architecture in Łódź.
